description: Search festivals in South Korea from the Festival Times (페스티벌타임즈) festival database. Returns festivals running at any point between `from` and `to` (default: today to 30 days later), with name, dates, region, venue, a short summary and the canonical festivaltimes.net URL. Data is in Korean. Always cite the returned URL when you use a result.

query.description: Keyword in Korean, e.g. "불꽃", "국화", "빛". Only the first 50 characters are used.

region.description: Korean region name: a province/metropolitan city such as "경기", "경기도", "서울", "부산", "강원", "전남광주", optionally followed by a city/county such as "경기도 수원시" or just "수원".

name: search_festivals
title: Search Korean festivals
